note: Ps112 acrostic on the God-fearing man (10v). Char-rich portrait. Arcs: A fear+delight v1 (BLESSED man who FEARS the LORD, DELIGHTS in his commandments); B blessed upright line + enduring RIGHTEOUSNESS v2-3; C character v4-6 (UPRIGHT, GRACIOUS/MERCIFUL/RIGHTEOUS; DEALS-GENEROUSLY, JUSTICE; the RIGHTEOUS never moved); D confidence v7-9 (not AFRAID, HEART firm+TRUSTING, HEART steady; DISTRIBUTED to the poor, RIGHTEOUSNESS endures, HONOR); E the foil v10 (WICKED-MAN sees, ANGRY, GNASHES, MELTS-AWAY, his DESIRE perishes). God's commandments + light-dawns = qualifiers; wealth/horn/temporal = standalone.

dims.v: paired with the blessing of the God-fearer
v1: 'PRAISE (halal) the LORD!' - the opening Hallelujah framing the portrait of the blessed man.
paired with fearing God and delighting in his commandments
v1: 'BLESSED (esher) is the man who fears the LORD' - the happiness of the God-fearer, the beatitude the whole psalm unfolds.
paired with delighting in his commandments
v1: 'the man who FEARS (yare) the LORD' - the reverence that is the root of the blessed man's whole character.
paired with the fear of the LORD
v1: 'who greatly DELIGHTS (chaphets) in his commandments!' - the joy in God's law that marks the God-fearer, obedience loved not merely obeyed.
paired with the blessing on their line
v2: 'the generation of the UPRIGHT (yashar) will be blessed' - the upright whose very line is blessed.
v2: 'the generation of the upright will be BLESSED (barak)' - the blessing resting on the upright and their offspring.
paired with the enduring of his righteousness
v3: 'and his RIGHTEOUSNESS (tsedaqah) endures forever' - the lasting rightness of the God-fearer, righteousness that outlasts wealth.
paired with the light that dawns for them
v4: 'Light dawns in the darkness for the UPRIGHT (yashar)' - the upright for whom light rises even in the dark.
paired with being merciful and righteous
v4: 'he is GRACIOUS (chanun), merciful, and righteous' - the God-fearer mirrors God's own grace toward others.
v4: 'gracious, MERCIFUL (rachum), and righteous' - the compassion of the God-fearer, God's mercy reflected in the man.
paired with being gracious and merciful
v4: 'gracious, merciful, and RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq)' - the uprightness of the God-fearer's conduct.
paired with conducting affairs with justice
v5: 'It is well with the man who DEALS GENEROUSLY (chanan) and lends' - the open-handed generosity of the God-fearer.
v5: 'who conducts his affairs with JUSTICE (mishpat)' - the just ordering of the God-fearer's business, fairness in all dealings.
v6: 'For the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) will never be moved' - the immovable stability of the righteous, rooted in God.
paired with the firm, trusting heart
v7: 'He is not AFRAID (yare) of bad news' - the fearlessness of the God-fearer, dread dissolved by trust.
paired with trusting in the LORD
v7: 'his HEART (leb) is firm, trusting in the LORD' - the settled inner self, firmness grounded in trust.
v7: 'his heart is firm, TRUSTING (batach) in the LORD' - the reliance on God that steadies the heart against fear.
v8: 'His HEART (leb) is steady; he will not be afraid' - the unshaken inner self, poised even before adversaries.
v8: 'he will not be AFRAID (yare)' - the composure of the God-fearer, confident until he sees his foes fall.
v9: 'He has DISTRIBUTED (pazar) freely; he has given to the poor' - the lavish generosity of the God-fearer, scattering to the needy.
paired with the horn exalted in honor
v9: 'his RIGHTEOUSNESS (tsedaqah) endures forever' - the lasting rightness of the generous man, righteousness that stands.
v9: 'his horn is exalted in HONOUR (kabod)' - the dignity God gives the God-fearer, exaltation crowning his righteousness.
paired with anger and melting away
v10: 'The WICKED MAN (rasha) sees it and is angry' - the godless foil, galled by the blessing of the righteous.
v10: 'sees it and is ANGRY (kaas)' - the fury of the wicked at the God-fearer's good, envy turned to rage.
paired with the anger and gnashing
v10: 'he gnashes his teeth and MELTS AWAY (masas)' - the wicked man dissolving in impotent frustration.
paired with the wicked's melting away
v10: 'the DESIRE (taavah) of the wicked will perish' - the craving of the wicked come to nothing, appetite frustrated forever.
